fusions.name: Sticky Reach
fusions.desc: Lashes out a sticky tongue that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 7 tiles. Each hit has a 25% chance to leave the target [Pinned] for 1 second.

fusions.name: Marsh Chorus
fusions.desc: Booms a narrow croak 5 tiles ahead that deals 12 damage to everything in it, stuns it for 1 second and leaves it [Muddled] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Lily Snare
fusions.desc: Takes 1 second to set a snapping trap at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 30 seconds, and the first enemy to come within 2 tiles sets it off: it deals 22 damage in a blast around it.

fusions.name: Last Hop
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 50%, a shield worth 25% of your maximum health closes over you for 6 seconds. You also have 8% more dodge chance. Once every 30 seconds.
